title: Spend Goodwill on Returns & Exchanges Card Charges
content:
When spent instant store credit from a Returns & Exchanges Store Credit Return is charged to the original card, Marlowe & Finch scales the spent shortfall by spend goodwill. The goodwill turns on the cardholder's Marlowe Rewards membership status and on the spend history weighed for goodwill.

## Spend goodwill

| Cardholder | Share of the spent shortfall charged |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active, spend history at least 3000 USD | 0.8 of it (80 percent) |
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active, spend history at least 1500 USD but below 3000 USD | 0.9 of it (90 percent) |
| Anyone else, including a membership not in status active | The spent shortfall itself |

The scaled amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Spend history (active membership) | Share charged |
|---|---|
| 3000.00 | 0.8 |
| 2999.99 | 0.9 |
| 1500.00 | 0.9 |
| 1499.99 | The whole spent shortfall |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Spent shortfall 43.50, active member, spend history 3200.00: 43.50 times 0.8 is 34.80.
- Spent shortfall 43.55, active member, spend history 1800.00: 43.55 times 0.9 is 39.195, rounded half up to 39.20.
- Spent shortfall 43.50, membership suspended, spend history 5000.00: 43.50, since the membership is not in status active.
